document.title: Zookeep Vision Specification
document.purpose: Describe the basic vision, mission, and outline of zookeep.
author: Lion Kimbro
ChatGPT

vision.basic: zookeep is a system for helping software projects come into being as repositories and helping keep them healthy and understandable over time.
vision.consistency: It should help projects have recognizable form without forcing every project into the same shape.
vision.change: It should help repositories stay coherent while still allowing mutation, growth, and the appearance of new breeds of project directory.
vision.ai: It should be usable by both people and AI agents.

mission.basic: Make it easier to start repository-based software projects well.
mission.care: Help keep repositories in good condition over time.
mission.inspection: Inspect repositories and point out strengths, weaknesses, and missing structure.
mission.breeds: Support different breeds of project directory rather than assuming one universal layout.

what-it-is: A system for creating repository-based software projects.
A system for inspecting and tending repositories over time.
A tool that supports both creation and ongoing care.
A tool that can work through CLI, GUI, or AI-driven use.
what-it-does: Helps support consistency without blocking development and change.
what-it-is-not: It is not the general zoo of all project forms.
It is not a build system.
It is not a replacement for git.
It is not a universal project manager.
